settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.subheading: Collector-grade protective packaging, fast tracked dispatch, and transparent 14-day return rules.
settings.card_1_text: In-stock orders placed before 16:00 CET ship the same or next business day with full parcel tracking.
settings.card_2_text: Every single card is double-sleeved, placed in a rigid toploader, sealed in a team bag, and packed in a water-resistant rigid mailer.
settings.card_3_text: Unopened sealed products and unaltered singles/slabs can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund.
